lesson.title: Learning to cook
lesson.title_ar: تعلّم الطبخ: وصفة كاري السمك ومخطط تسلسل البيض المخفوق

lines: 4.3 Learning to cook
James is interested in learning to cook. His mother teaches him how to make a fish curry.
Listen to the conversation. Answer the questions in Workbook activity A. Listen and repeat the conversation.
James: What are you doing, mum?
Mother: I'm making a fish curry.
[Ask about ingredients] James: That sounds good. And these are the ingredients?
Mother: Yes, I always prepare them before I start cooking.
James: So... that's the fish ... and the tomatoes and onions ... and that's garlic, isn't it?
[Name ingredients] Mother: Yes. Two peeled and chopped tomatoes, two chopped onions, and three crushed cloves of garlic.
James: What's that round, brown thing?
Mother: It's a loomi - a small, dried lime.
James: And those other things... they're spices, I suppose.
Mother: Yes, two teaspoons of baharat - that's a mixture of spices. And ... half a teaspoon of turmeric, half a teaspoon of chilli powder and a quarter of a teaspoon of ground ginger.
James: What's in this bowl?
Mother: Lemon juice... about one teaspoon.
James: Anything else?
Mother: Oil for frying, and, of course, salt and pepper.
[Ask about method] James: So those are the ingredients. How do you actually cook the curry, then?

[Describe method] Mother: First you fry the onions and garlic. Then you add the spices and fry for a further two minutes. Next you add the tomatoes, loomi, lemon juice, salt and pepper. After that, you cover the mixture with water and simmer for fifteen minutes.
James: What about the fish?
Mother: While the mixture is boiling gently, you fry the pieces of fish.
James: How long for?
Mother: Until they are golden brown. Then you put the fish into the sauce and simmer for a further fifteen minutes... and that's it... fish curry. Simple, isn't it?
Now do activities B and C in the Workbook.

interactive_spot.label: قاموس المكونات وصفات التحضير وأدوات التسلسل في الحوار

simple_explain.html:
• صفات المكونات (Past Participle as Adjective): peeled (مقشّرة)، chopped (مفرومة/مقطّعة)، crushed (مهروسة)، dried (مجفّفة — اللومي = الليمون الأسود المجفف)، ground (مطحون — التصريف الثالث من grind).
  • تسلسل الخطوات والزمن: لاحظ ربط الحدثين المتزامنين بـ While the mixture is boiling gently, you fry the pieces of fish (تُمهد لقاعدة Language review 7 #3).
  • معنى simmer: يُفهم مباشرةً من حوار الأم حين قالت: simmer for fifteen minutes → While the mixture is boiling gently...!

example.html: Verb → Participial adjective: peel → peeled tomatoes; crush → crushed garlic; grind → ground ginger.

further.ar: إضافي (مثل further two minutes: دقيقتين إضافيتين)

simmer.ar: يغلي على نار هادئة / ينضج على مهل

activities.prompt_literal: 4.3 A Read PB page 26 and write short answers to these questions.
activities.prompt_ar: أجب باختصار عن الأسئلة 1–10 حول وصفة كاري السمك في PB ص 26:

items.question: 1 What are ingredients?
items.model_answer: The things (foods and spices) used to make a dish.

items.question: 2 When does James' mother prepare her ingredients?
items.explain_ar: نصّاً: I always prepare them before I start cooking.

items.question: 3 What does she do to the tomatoes?
items.model_answer: She peels and chops them (peeled and chopped tomatoes).
items.explain_ar: تقشرها وتفرمها (Two peeled and chopped tomatoes).

items.question: 4 What does she do to the cloves of garlic?
items.model_answer: She crushes them (three crushed cloves of garlic).

items.question: 5 How many spices does she use?
items.model_answer: Four (baharat, turmeric, chilli powder and ground ginger).
items.explain_ar: لاحظ أن baharat نفسه مزيج توابل، وإلى جانبه الكركم والفلفل الأحمر والزنجبيل المطحون.

items.question: 6 What does she fry the ingredients in?
7 Which ingredients go in first?
items.explain_ar: First you fry the onions and garlic.

items.question: 8 What goes in next?
items.model_answer: The spices (fried for two minutes), and then ('Next') the tomatoes, loomi, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
items.explain_ar: يلي البصل والثوم التوابل أولاً (Then you add the spices)، ثم تليها الطماطم واللومي وعصير الليمون والملح والفلفل (Next...).

items.question: 9 The word 'simmer' means: a) fry [ ]  b) boil gently [ ]  c) grill. [ ]
items.explain_ar: تُستنتج مباشرة من قولها بعد ذلك: While the mixture is boiling gently...

items.question: 10 For how long does she fry the pieces of fish?
items.explain_ar: لم تذكر مدة بالدقائق بل معيار اللون: Until they are golden brown.

hints: السؤال 9 (simmer = boil gently) حُسم نصياً من ردّ الأم على سؤال What about the fish?.

activities.prompt_literal: B Look at these sentences and guess the meaning of heat, melt and stir.
activities.prompt_ar: استنتج معاني الأفعال heat وmelt وstir من سياق الجملتين 1 و2 (WB ص 43):

items.prompt: 1 heat (e.g., heat ice / heat food quickly): to ______
2 melt (When you heat ice, it melts and changes to water): ______
3 stir (stir it with a wooden spoon to stop it burning): ______

hints: 1: يسخّن، 2: يذوب/ينصهر (الثلج إلى ماء)، 3: يحرّك/يقلّب بالملعقة.

activities.prompt_literal: C Use the flow chart to tell your partner how to cook scrambled eggs.. [Ingredients: eggs (3 for each person), butter, milk, salt and pepper.]
activities.prompt_ar: حوّل مخطط إعداد البيض المخفوق (scrambled eggs) إلى وصفة شفهية كاملة بروابط التسلسل:
activities.guidance_literal: HEAT PAN → MELT BUTTER → ADD MILK → BREAK EGGS INTO PAN → COOK FOR 5/6 MINUTES → STIR EGGS → ADD SALT AND PEPPER

steps.label_ar: 1) الخطوات الثلاث الأولى (تسخين المقلاة وإضافة الزبدة والحليب)
steps.placeholder: First, heat a pan. Next, melt some butter in it and add some milk.
Then break the eggs into the pan (3 for each person) and cook them for five or six minutes while stirring the eggs.

hints: لاحظ وجود ثلاث نقاط هامة: ربط الخطوات بكلمات التسلسل، ذكر كمية البيض من خانة Ingredients، واستعمال while كما في وصفة الأم.

questions.stem: In PB page 26, what is 'baharat' and how is 'ground ginger' prepared?

options.text: 'Baharat' is a mixture of spices, and 'ground' means crushed/powdered (past participle of grind).
'Baharat' is a dried lime, and 'ground' means fresh from the soil.
options.why_wrong: الليمون المجفف هو loomi، أما ground هنا فصفة بمعنى مطحون (التصريف الثالث من grind).

options.text: 'Baharat' means turmeric only, and 'ground' means fried.
options.why_wrong: الكركم (turmeric) ذُكر بوصفه نوعاً آخر مع الفلفل والزنجبيل، وليس مرادفاً لـ baharat.

options.text: 'Baharat' is a kind of fish, and 'ground' means peeled.
options.why_wrong: وصفت الأم بهارات حرفياً بأنه: that's a mixture of spices.

hints: اقرأ كلام الأم بعد: Yes, two teaspoons of baharat...
questions.explain: ذكرت الأم نصياً أن baharat هو خليط بهارات، وground هي الصفة من الفعل grind (يطحن).

questions.stem: How do you know from PB page 26 that 'simmer' (WB 4.3 A #9) means 'boil gently'?

options.text: Because right after saying 'simmer for fifteen minutes', Mother explains 'While the mixture is boiling gently...'
Because Mother tells James to grill the onions and garlic.
options.why_wrong: البصل والثوم يُقليان (fry) في الزيت، لا يُشويان.

options.text: Because James says 'It's a small, dried lime'.
options.why_wrong: هذه جملة تعريف loomi وليس simmer.

options.text: Because the curry must never be heated with water.
options.why_wrong: بل تغطي الخليط بالماء (cover the mixture with water) وتتركه يغلي برفق.

hints: قارن السطر الأخير في Describe method بالسطر الذي يليه مباشرةً.
questions.explain: استعاضت الأم عن كلمة simmer في الجملة التالية بالعبارة الشارحة boiling gently.

flashcards.back: يغلي برفق على نار هادئة (boil gently)
